versions.content: If more than one core calls StartOS with an AppMode other than DONOTCARE , the AppModes shall be the same. StartOS shall check this at the first synchronization point. In case of violation, StartOS shall not start the scheduling, shall not call any StartupHook s, and shall enter an endless loop on every core.
